info.name: VICTIM AND MITSI
info.description: depicts a serene, idyllic scene of two characters—one resembling a stick figure and the other a girl in a white dress—relaxing together on a lush green meadow. Surrounding them are fluffy white sheep, adding to the peaceful, pastoral setting. The girl appears to be lying back with her hands behind her head, enjoying the calm atmosphere, while the stick figure character rests casually with a relaxed posture. The vibrant green grass and soft clouds overhead enhance the tranquil and dreamlike mood of the artwork.
